title: The Navigation Tool
desc: Explore how the navigation tool shows your path on the map and helps you plan your route.
task: Follow the routes on the map and mark the important points.
explanation: The navigation tool records your path on the map and shows important points. This helps you plan your route across the island and not lose track of where you've been.

quiz.question: What does the navigation tool do?
options: A) Shows your path on the map
quiz.feedback: It records your route and important points.

quiz.question: Why do you mark important points?
options: A) So you don't forget the way
quiz.feedback: Marked points help you orient yourself.

quiz.question: What can you see on the map?
options: A) Your route and marked points
quiz.feedback: The map shows your route and marked points.

test.question: Why is the route on the map important?
options: A) So you don't get lost
test.feedback: The route helps you keep an overview.

test.question: What do you plan with the navigation tool?
options: A) Your route across the island
test.feedback: You plan your route across the island.
